title: Salesforce and Microsoft launch Copilotforce to connect CRM data with Microsoft Copilot
summary: Salesforce and Microsoft launch Copilotforce to connect CRM data with Copilot
detailed: Salesforce and Microsoft launched Copilotforce, a service integrating Salesforce CRM data directly with Microsoft Copilot, Teams, and Microsoft Fabric.
The service allows sales teams to analyze opportunities, prepare for meetings, and execute CRM actions using natural language queries grounded in work context.
Key executives involved include Miguel Milano, President and Chief Operating Officer of Salesforce.
This matters because it embeds enterprise CRM data into primary productivity workflows, combining Salesforce insights with Microsoft's Work IQ to drive faster decision-making.
sentences: Sales teams will be able to use customer data alongside context from Microsoft apps to analyze opportunities, prepare for meetings and take CRM actions.
Microsoft and Salesforce announced Copilotforce, a service that brings together their AI platforms and customer data services.
The service connects Salesforce’s CRM with Microsoft Copilot, with integrations across Copilot, Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Fabric.
Through Copilotforce, we’re bringing Salesforce to the largest surface in enterprise software today, embedding trusted Salesforce context and intelligent sales workflows directly where sellers work.

By bringing together the #1 CRM with the #1 productivity surface, we’re transforming AI from a standalone tool into a powerful driver of productivity, smarter decisions, and customer success.
- Miguel Milano, President and Chief Operating Officer, Salesforce
Copilotforce is intended to help customers find insights in and analyze their customer data more effectively.

Salespeople will be able to access Salesforce customer context, analyze and prioritize opportunities, prepare for meetings, and take CRM actions informed by conversations in Teams, emails in Outlook and shared documents.
The service builds on Sales Cloud in Teams, announced at the recent Dreamforce 2026 event.
It lets salespeople prepare for meetings in Copilot or Teams and update supported opportunity details in Teams.
Users can ask questions in natural language and receive answers or actions based on their own data.
Microsoft’s Work IQ combines Salesforce insights with relevant relationships and content from Teams meetings, Outlook emails and shared documents across SharePoint and OneDrive.
AI is only as powerful as the data and context that grounds it.

Bringing Salesforce customer data and sales skills together with the work context delivered by Work IQ in Microsoft Copilot allows our joint customers to unlock actionable insights across their core business applications.
Copilotforce will give sales teams the intelligence they need to make faster, higher-confidence decisions while maintaining the governance and trust enterprises demand.
